title: Harbringer of Change
dek: Three themes. Nine boons. Compare the effects and costs below.
sources: Fenumion 21–25 · Harbringer of Change · A1:H60 · checked 17 October 2026 · https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qk8H3SMq7-8_raesIkaPdNoq4XqgNsJpZRStwlg278o/edit#gid=2051605216

← Browse all blessings

Read down each theme to compare its three tiers. Each boon shows its listed cost. Open “Full original wording” for the complete passage, including its descriptive text.

Tier 11cost
Tier 22cost
Tier 33cost
Theme 1

The Fluxblade

Tier 1Cost 1

When you miss an attack, you may immediately shift your position up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

Full original wording

"Even in failure, your footwork is flawless; a missed blow simply guides you into a better position. When you miss an attack, you may immediately shift your position up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

Tier 2Cost 2

Your mind works in motion—when allies falter, you shift the plan, turning their failure into a new path forward. Three times per long rest, after seeing a willing creature, other than yourself, rolling an attack, ability check, or saving throw, you can roll again and choose which result to use.

Full original wording

Your mind works in motion—when allies falter, you shift the plan, turning their failure into a new path forward. Three times per long rest, after seeing a willing creature, other than yourself, rolling an attack, ability check, or saving throw, you can roll again and choose which result to use.

Tier 3Cost 3

Once per short rest, when you miss with an attack, you may immediately make another attack against a different target within reach or range.

Full original wording

Your weapon moves like water—when denied one path, it finds another. Once per short rest, when you miss with an attack, you may immediately make another attack against a different target within reach or range.

Theme 2

The Fatebreaker

Tier 1Cost 1

Gain advantage on initiative rolls.

Full original wording

The moment danger rises, you are already ahead of it—first to act, first to shape the field. Gain advantage on initiative rolls.

Tier 2Cost 2

Once per long rest, force a creature you can see to reroll an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check and take the new result.

Full original wording

Reality hesitates when you act, giving you just enough space to reshape what was meant to be. Once per long rest, force a creature you can see to reroll an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check and take the new result.

Tier 3Cost 3

A number of times equal to your proficiency modifier, you may change the outcome of a single roll you take or force another to take. Over 10 to a natural 20, or a roll under 10 to a 1. You must declare this before the roll

Full original wording

Moments that define destiny do not define you—you define them. A number of times equal to your proficiency modifier, you may change the outcome of a single roll you take or force another to take. Over 10 to a natural 20, or a roll under 10 to a 1. You must declare this before the roll

Theme 3

The Evershifter

Tier 1Cost 1

You may choose to swap places with an willling creature within 30 feet as a bonus action once per short rest.

Full original wording

You move like a shadow on water—effortless, sudden, and untraceable. In one breath, you are elsewhere. You may choose to swap places with an willling creature within 30 feet as a bonus action once per short rest.

Tier 2Cost 2

Gain advantage on saving throws against grapples, restraints, or any effect that limits movement.

Full original wording

No chains can bind you, no force can pin you—your will slips through all restraint. Gain advantage on saving throws against grapples, restraints, or any effect that limits movement.

Tier 3Cost 3

Once per long rest, you may transform your appearance into that of another humanoid creature of your size and keep that form until you choose to change back. This is purely physical (not magical disguise).

Full original wording

Your true nature is hidden beneath layers so convincing, even the keenest eyes see only what you allow. Once per long rest, you may transform your appearance into that of another humanoid creature of your size and keep that form until you choose to change back. This is purely physical (not magical disguise).
